name: Mentorcam
long_description: Mentorcam is a marketplace for 1:1 business and career advice.
one_liner: Mentorship from leaders of the world's best companies

founders.title: Founder
founders.founder_bio: Rune Hauge is the CEO of Mentorcam and has 10+ years of experience building and scaling startups. He previously founded apparel brand Hardhaus (acquired) and video shopping software startup Preplay. An avid skier, he can often be found on a remote mountaintop somewhere in the Rockies when he's not working on Mentorcam.

founders.title: Founder
founders.founder_bio:
As a kid, I taught myself how to design and code. I have founded startups backed by tier-1 investors like Y Combinator. Besides, I have single-handedly designed and built apps for companies like Aston Martin, Lamborghini, Maserati, as well as for Series A and seed-stage AI startups.

I do the heavy lifting on product; I talk to users → I design → I code → I ship → I iterate → I build teams. I do these by mastering Figma, Vue.js, Nuxt.js, Ember.js, Typescript, Node.js, MongoDB, Firebase, Redis.
